doc.title: Chazz Frichtel interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 13, 2016

title: Blindfold test and the Chick Esposito Big Band
summary: An audio clip turns out to be the Chick Esposito big band that both men played in, with its Italian-named players.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: So I have a little — remember the blindfold tests in DownBeat?
Okay I have a couple of little musical examples here.
Oh is it really? Oh yeah, is this Chick’s Big Band?
Oh fantastic. You know I have a reel to reel of this in my tape box that I need to transfer. Oh man. Is this “Ugetsu?”
This is — I can’t remember the name of it. It was one of his sort of rock type of — starts with a T — Tam — whatever.
But yeah, that was a fun band. It was a good experience for us. You and I were sort of a little out of the loop with everybody else had a vowel at the end of their name.
You had Esposito and Montalbano and Robilatto. This area had so many great musicians of Italian descent.
